facts.zuylen1981_realistic_formula: d = lambda / (1.3 NA) under uncontrolled lighting; 1.7 with good modern lens and central illumination; old biconvex lenses rarely exceed 1.5, as low as 0.5
facts.zuylen1981_rayleigh_limit: spherical aberration limit = centre intensity reduced to 80% (Strehl 0.8); free aperture chosen at 2-5x Rayleigh limit; with parallel light useful images up to 20x
